modules.module_title: Carry out Welding Operations (Arc and Gas Welding) MSME/CCWT/03

pcs.pc_description: Describe Arc & Gas welding equipment
Describe various welding process & their application
• Describe use of electricity & various electric terms, application & • importance of heat & temperature in welding 31.3
Perform arc welding operation using various welding instrument
Differentiate AC & DC welding machines
Describe arc length & its effects
Describe importance of electrode, fluxes, coating, size & its coding

• Describe and demonstrate working of oxy- acetylene low presser & high • presser in welding system
Demonstrate right & left ward welding technique
Identify defects, cause, remedies & controlling during Arc welding
Describe about filler rod, specification & size fluxes, types & its functions
Know about welds slop & rotation

Demonstrate use of equipment in GMAW/GTAW
Describe the difference between GMAW over SMAW
Describe wire feed system its type & maintenance
Identify various wire used in GMAW as per standard
Perform edge preparation for various metals
Perform pre heating & post weld treatment
Describe sub merged Arc welding process its principle, equipment, advantage & limitation.
Describe about GTAW process 36.15
Describe tungsten electrode type & its use
Identify various filler rod & its selection
• Identify various parameter of welding in GTAW and pulsed TIG welding • Gas welding
Perform Weld of MS sheet with filler rod & without filler rod

Perform weld of vertical position with filler road on MS sheet 3.15 mm

• Perform straight bead, bevel bead, open corner, ‘T’, Lap, Open square, • Single ‘V’ butt on 10 mm plate

Perform joining of MS plate with MS pipe Perform hard facing
